name: Have a Heart
description: Have a Heart is a classic trick-taking game from the Hearts family. Unlike most trick-taking games, the goal is to avoid winning certain cards. Hearts and the Queen of Spades carry penalty points. It is a game of evasion and strategic passing, requiring players to carefully manage their hand to avoid 'bleeding' points.

content.text: Have a Heart is a classic trick-taking game from the Hearts family. Unlike most trick-taking games, the goal is to avoid winning certain cards. Hearts and the Queen of Spades carry penalty points. It is a game of evasion and strategic passing, requiring players to carefully manage their hand to avoid 'bleeding' points.

Derived from the 18th-century French game 'Reversis', Hearts evolved in the US during the late 19th century. 'Have a Heart' specifically refers to the standard evasion variant often played with a central betting pot.
Usually 4 individual players. Can be adapted for 3, 5, or 6 by removing certain low cards.
Standard 52-card deck. Ranks: Ace (high) down to 2.
The entire deck is dealt out one card at a time. In a 4-player game, each player receives 13 cards.

items.text: Omnibus Hearts: The Jack of Diamonds is worth -10 points (a bonus).
Black Jack: The Jack of Spades is the penalty card instead of the Queen.
